# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Brierley Academy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** rose-red girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking young woman with dark eyes. She is considered the top beauty among the Second Year classes at the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart filled with romantic dreams and vivid, multicolored imaginations. She is contemplative, creative, and driven in her studies.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- striking  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Abilities

- scholarship  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

Mabel attended the Academy as a scholar, placing among the Second Year students. During her time there, she became part of a close circle of thoughtful, creative, and driven scholars surrounding Nell Harcourt, developing a close friendship with her. She was recognized as the beauty prize winner among the Second Year classes.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_
